name: Annihilate the Unworthy
summary: Friendly Knight Tyrant attacks get +1 to hit when targeting a Battle-shocked unit.

name: Masters of the Pack
summary: If 2 or more friendly War Dog models are within range of a Titanic Chaos Knights unit's own Aura ability that affects War Dogs, that Titanic unit benefits from its own aura too.

name: Marked Prey
summary: Each Command phase, mark an enemy unit: visible War Dog attacks against it gain Sustained Hits 1 until your next Command phase. Requires 3+ War Dog units, which gain Battleline; three of them gain Character.

name: Scenting Fear
summary: Once per battle round, in your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly War Dog unit; it has +6" detection range. This detachment carries the War Dogs tag and cannot be taken with another War Dogs detachment.

name: Wretched Thralls
summary: Allows including Damned units up to 500 points; friendly Damned units can re-roll Leadership tests.

name: Malefic Surge
summary: In your Command phase, a Chaos Knights unit may take a Leadership test, D3 mortal wounds on a fail, to be Empowered until your next Command phase; spend it for +3" Move, Lethal Hits, Sustained Hits 1, 5+ invulnerable or Feel No Pain 6+.

name: Tyrannical Court
summary: Chaos Knights Character models get +2 Objective Control. Once per battle round, while your Warlord is on the battlefield, use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.

name: Paragons of Terror
summary: At the first battle round, after selecting your army's Dread abilities, add one further Dread ability of your choice (not randomly selected).
